Description: Defines the polling intervals, in seconds, that the workflow uses when checking the status of a Qualys scan. Enter the intervals as a list in the order they should be used by the workflow.
Validation: Must be a JSON-style list of positive whole numbers representing polling intervals in seconds.

Description: Defines the maximum number of times the workflow should retry checking the Qualys scan status before treating the status check as unsuccessful. Enter a whole number.
Validation: Must be a whole number greater than or equal to 0.

Description: Defines the working days and business-hour window used by the business-day calculation. Configure the working days, start time, end time, and region in the corresponding configuration fields.
Validation: businessDays must contain day numbers 1-7; startTime and endTime must use HH:mm:ss; region must be a configured region.

Description: Defines the default end time of the business-day working-hours window. Enter the time using HH:MM:SS format.
Validation: Must use HH:mm:ss format (24-hour time).

Description: Defines the default start time of the business-day working-hours window. Enter the time using HH:MM:SS format.
Validation: Must use HH:mm:ss format (24-hour time).

Description: Defines the default region whose business-day and holiday calendar is used when no specific region is provided.
Validation: Must be a configured region name.

Description: Defines the default time zone used when calculating business hours and business days. Use a valid IANA time-zone name.
Validation: Must be a valid IANA time-zone name.

Description: Defines the default working days used by the workflow. Use numbers from 1 to 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday, and enter the selected days as a list.
Validation: Must be a list containing only whole numbers 1-7.

Description: Defines the end time of the business-hours window for the APAC region. Enter the time using HH:MM:SS format.
Validation: Must use HH:mm:ss format (24-hour time).

Description: Defines the start time of the business-hours window for the APAC region. Enter the time using HH:MM:SS format.
Validation: Must use HH:mm:ss format (24-hour time).

Description: Defines the time zone used for business-day calculations in the APAC region. Use a valid IANA time-zone name.
Validation: Must be a valid IANA time-zone name.

Description: Defines the working days used for the APAC region. Use numbers from 1 to 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday, and enter the selected days as a list.
Validation: Must be a list containing only whole numbers 1-7.

Description: Defines the end time of the business-hours window for the Europe region. Enter the time using HH:MM:SS format.
Validation: Must use HH:mm:ss format (24-hour time).

Description: Defines the start time of the business-hours window for the Europe region. Enter the time using HH:MM:SS format.
Validation: Must use HH:mm:ss format (24-hour time).

Description: Defines the time zone used for business-day calculations in the Europe region. Use a valid IANA time-zone name.
Validation: Must be a valid IANA time-zone name.

Description: Defines the working days used for the Europe region. Use numbers from 1 to 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday, and enter the selected days as a list.

Description: Defines the end time of the business-hours window for the US region. Enter the time using HH:MM:SS format.

Validation: Must be a list containing only whole numbers 1-7.

Description: Defines the recipients and notification template used for each follow-up escalation level. Provide the configuration as the expected JSON-style object mapping each escalation level to its recipients and template.
Validation: Must be a JSON-style list of positive whole numbers.

Description: Defines how many hours the workflow waits before sending the first follow-up notification. Enter a whole number representing hours.
Validation: Must be a whole number greater than or equal to 0.

Description: Defines the maximum number of follow-up notifications that can be sent before the workflow performs the final escalation. Enter a whole number.
Validation: Must be a whole number greater than or equal to 0.

Description: Defines the notification subject and importance used for each follow-up type. Provide the configuration as the expected JSON-style object containing the Standard, Escalation, and HighPriority templates.
SampleValue: {Standard:{Subject:Reminder: Action Required - {TaskName},Importance:Normal},Escalation:{Subject:ESCALATION: Overdue Action - {TaskName},Importance:High},HighPriority:{Subject:URGENT: Critical Overdue Action - {TaskName},Importance:High}}

Description: Defines the Azure Storage Queue name used to schedule and process follow-up activities. Enter the queue name configured for the environment.
Validation: Must be a valid Azure Storage Queue name (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; 3-63 characters).

Description: Defines how many hours the workflow waits between subsequent follow-up notifications. Enter a whole number representing hours.
Validation: Must be a whole number greater than or equal to 0.

Description: Defines the notification channels used by default when no specific channel is configured. Enter the supported channels as a list, such as Email and Teams.
Validation: Must be a list containing supported notification channels such as Email and Teams.

Description: Defines the sender email address used for email notifications. Enter a valid email address that is permitted to send notifications.
Validation: Must be one valid email address.

Description: Defines the SMTP server hostname used for email notification delivery. Enter the SMTP server name configured for the environment.
Validation: Must be a valid SMTP server hostname.

Description: Defines the Azure Storage Queue name used to deliver notification requests. Enter the queue name configured for the environment.
Validation: Must be a valid Azure Storage Queue name (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; 3-63 characters).

Description: Defines the Microsoft Teams webhook URL used to deliver Teams notifications. Enter the webhook URL provided for the target Teams channel.
Validation: Must be a valid HTTPS URL.
